name: Describe Sales Person
summary: Shows the Sales Person object: its key fields (id, externalSalesPersonId, email) and the fields you can query by.
whenToUse: Before working with sales person records — to see the structure and valid filters.

response.description: Object metadata: idField (id), dedupeFields (externalSalesPersonId), searchableFields, field list.

notes: Sales Persons only exist on instances with SFDC or Dynamics Sync enabled, and are only editable via the API (not the Marketo UI).
